DOCUMENTATION

Content review

The published collection contains 28 screened records, each with an “Include” decision from the 17 September 2026 review.

The 19 records labelled “Include with limits” are omitted from the public data, downloads and detail pages. The original catalogue and full review are retained in the local editorial source files. Inclusion is an editorial decision, not an independent methodological quality rating.

Download the 28 screening decisions
